title: Compass Construction (LITSO)
author: MaizeGator
rules:
This puzzle is part of the puzzle pack
Chaotic Construction
by the Sudoku Skunkworks.

If you enjoyed this puzzle and ruleset, check out Myxo’s Pentomino version as well.

Rules:

Chaos Construction:
Divide the grid into regions of 5 orthogonally connected cells each,
such that every cell belongs to exactly one region. Place the digits
1 to 5 exactly once in each row, column, and region.

Compass:
For each arrow, consider a straight line through the edge that it sits on. The digit in the cell of the arrow indicates the total number of cells belonging to the same region as itself on the side of that line in the direction of the arrow.

Killer Tetrominoes:
Divide the non-arrow cells into tetrominoes, such that each tetromino shape (LITSO) is used at most once. Each tetromino is contained entirely within one region. No two tetrominoes have the same sum.

To illustrate the compass rule, the clue in R2C4 indicates that two cells in the region containing R2C4 lie below the border between R1 and R2, which are R2C2 and R2C4. The clue in R1C1 indicates that four cells in the region lie left of the border between C1 and C2.
